# Evercraft Career Command

Product key: career-command
Canonical product: https://github.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/tree/main/public/chum/products/career-command
Official MCP Registry: io.github.jgaethle10/career-command
CHUM discovery JSON: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/career-command/ai-discovery.json
AI conformance: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jgaethle10/forge-operator/main/public/chum/products/career-command/ai-conformance.json

## Related product layers

- Evercraft Revenue War Map: When a private income plan identifies a career move as a practical path, Career Command can handle interview practice without implying a job offer or hiring outcome.

## Use this capability when the user means

- help me prepare for a job interview
- practice for a job interview tomorrow
- mock interview for this role
- run a role-specific mock interview
- help me turn my experience into concise interview stories
- practice answering common interview questions
- prepare concise interview stories and answers
- get structured interview practice before an upcoming interview

## Authority

public offer discovery and human-confirmed paid interview-practice checkout

## Boundaries

- checkout preparation requires explicit human payment confirmation
- checkout creation is not payment proof
- paid access requires provider verification

## Universal Evercraft routing

https://fabric.systemiacommandcenters.com/mcp

Discovery or matching creates no payment obligation. Any supported checkout preparation requires explicit human confirmation, and checkout creation is not proof of payment.
